final_opacity_rebuild.note: After the 46 passing JVM tests, the sole final production change set the API-31-guarded overlay window opacity. Both variants, lint and packaging were rerun; unrelated JVM tests were not repeated. Only APKs from this final rebuild are recorded below.

lint_debug.note: Dependency update notices were retained; no production dependencies were added.

regression_coverage: Pending requests cannot consume frames until their handler-confined owner has detached, drained and armed capture.
Stale cancellation and resize callbacks preserve newer unprepared requests.
RGBA plane packing accepts absent final-row padding and preserves source buffer state.
Canceled delivery releases resource leases; asynchronous readers keep their own lease until settlement.
Overlay placement stays within viewport edges while source OCR coordinates remain unchanged.
SSE completion, errors, interrupted streams, numbered line coverage and successful-cache behavior.

touch_passthrough.implementation: On API 31+, the full-screen non-touchable translation window uses InputManager.maximumObscuringOpacityForTouch as its LayoutParams.alpha. The interactive bubble is unchanged.
touch_passthrough.evidence: Code inference from official Android overlay rules, plus compilation and lint; not verified on a device.

remaining_checks: Grant and revoke capture/overlay permissions on a real Android device.
Repeat capture/cancel on static and moving screens and measure latency/memory.
Rotate during capture, OCR and streaming; verify alignment and edge placement.
Confirm Android 12+ touch and scroll passthrough while translations are visible.

environment_recovery: The Gradle distribution download exceeded the previous 10-second timeout; the wrapper now allows 60 seconds.
Pre-existing Gradle 8.9 generated Kotlin DSL and transform cache metadata was missing. Only the affected generated caches were backed up and regenerated; downloaded modules were retained.

An earlier compilation snapshot preceded final helper edits and produced unresolved-reference test compilation errors. The frozen-source full regression and final isolated-property rebuild both subsequently passed.
